Hyundai Creta

The Hyundai Creta remains one of the most well-rounded compact SUVs in the segment, positioned as a premium, feature-rich family SUV. It stands out for its broad powertrain lineup, which includes naturally aspirated petrol, turbo-petrol, and diesel options, alongside a spacious cabin and modern technology. The refreshed design, ADAS suite, six airbags, and connected-car features further enhance its appeal and widens its customer base. Overall, the Creta feels refined, comfortable, and easy to live with, making it a no-nonsense choice for buyers looking for a practical, well-equipped compact SUV in this segment.

Hyundai Creta Latest Update

Last Updated on 28th Apr'25 : The Hyundai Creta remains the top-selling SUV in Hyundai India’s lineup. The brand has recently experienced a significant increase in SUV sales in the Indian market, with around 68.5% of Hyundai cars sold in India being SUVs. The Creta continues to be the bestseller in the mid-size SUV segment despite a decline in the segment's sales. It comes with 3 engine options and multiple transmission options to cater to different kinds of buyers. 

Hyundai Creta has been around for quite sometime and while it stays as one of the top selling SUVs in its class, the rumour mill suggests that the next gen Hyundai Creta is already under works and is expected to hit Indian shores by 2027. As for now, the Creta EV has been launched in India, directly rivalling the eVitara from Maruti.

The Creta has maintained its position as a frontrunner in mid-size SUV sales, owing to its attractive design, feature-rich interior, and extensive range of safety features. Recently, the manufacturer introduced a facelift for the SUV, incorporating new design elements, additional safety features, expanded engine options, and an upgraded interior with a more premium feel. Undoubtedly, the Creta remains a visually appealing SUV packed with a wide array of features.

Pros & Cons of Creta

What we admire in this car

The Creta is one of the most feature-loaded SUV in the segment.

It offers refined petrol, turbo petrol and diesel engine option with smooth automatic transmission

The Creta offers well-equipped base variants and a wide range of trims to suit different budgets and needs.

The suspension of the SUV is well-tuned offering a comfortable ride

Comes loaded with features like 10.25-inch touchscreen infotainment, 360-degree camera, BOSE premium sound system, panoramic sunroof

The safety kit includes a good number of features starting from the base variant such as 6 airbags, hill assist control, all 4-disc brakes, level 2 ADAS

Hyundai Creta is one of the top-selling SUVs with a strong resale value

Hyundai’s widespread sales and service network is a boon for customers

What could have been better

Not everyone may like the Creta's design language

The soft suspension may not provide much comfort for the rear passenger

The turbo petrol engine option is available with DCT only and comes with a high price tag

Automatic transmission is limited to a few variants

Certain variants come with a higher price tag, and you can find larger SUVs within the same price range

Should I buy the Creta?

If you're looking for a compact SUV that excels as an all-around family car, the Hyundai Creta combines a premium cabin, extensive feature list, multiple powertrain options, and a comfortable driving experience in a package that appeals to a wide range of buyers. The addition of ADAS and enhanced safety features further strengthens its value proposition. While rivals may offer specific advantages such as hybrid technology or AWD, few match the Creta's balance of refinement, practicality, technology, and ease of ownership. For most buyers, it remains one of the safest and no-nonsense picks in the segment.

4Design
  • The front design of the Creta facelift showcases a unique style, setting it apart from the typical Hyundai SUVs in India. Nevertheless, it incorporates certain familiar design elements seen in Hyundai models worldwide. The latest Hyundai Creta showcases a striking design, featuring a distinctive front profile highlighted by new Signature Horizon LED positioning lamps and DRLs, a black chrome parametric radiator grille, and quad-beam LED headlamps, lending it a commanding presence.
  • At the rear, the redesigned Hyundai Creta boasts all-new signature connected LED tail lamps, a new tailgate, redesigned bumpers and skid plate, and a fresh aerodynamic spoiler. On the sides, it is equipped with 17-inch sharper and sportier diamond-cut alloy wheels.

Creta body specifications:

Seating Capacity5 seaters

4.5Features
  • The enhanced interior of the new Creta exudes a premium ambiance, boasting refined interiors with a horizontally redesigned dashboard seamlessly integrating a 10.25-inch infotainment screen and a 10.25-inch digital instrument cluster screen. It also gets Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. For a premium sound experience the Creta comes with BOSE premium sound system. 
  • The cabin features luxurious leatherette seats adorned with modern graphics, leatherette-covered door armrests, a leatherette D-Cut steering wheel, and a leatherette-wrapped gear shifter. Additional amenities include rear headrest cushions, ambient lighting, a rear seat with a two-step recline function, and more.
  • In terms of features, the updated Creta introduces a multitude of new additions, including dual-zone climate control, a panoramic sunroof, an eight-speaker Bose sound system, ventilated front seats, an eight-way powered driver's seat, and a Level 2 Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) suite with 19 functions. The array extends to encompass a 360-degree camera system, a blind-spot monitoring system, and various other enhancements, further elevating the overall appeal of the Creta.

Creta features:

TPMSYes
Wireless ChargerYes - Front & Rear

4.5Safety
  • The safety features of the all-new Hyundai Creta include several standard elements such as six airbags, all four disc brakes, ABS with EBD, ESC, Hill Assist Control, all five three-point seat belts, ISOFIX child seat mounts, rear parking sensors, among other notable features.
  • The top-spec versions are equipped with a Level 2 Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) suite featuring 19 functions. Additional features include a 360-degree camera system, a blind-spot monitoring system, and more, enhancing the appeal of the updated Creta.

Creta safety specifications:

ADASYes
Parking SensorFront & Rear
4.5Engine
  • The latest Hyundai Creta is available with three engine choices— petrol, turbo petrol and diesel. The naturally aspirated petrol engine produces115 PS of power and 144 Nm of peak torque, while the diesel engine generates 116 PS of power and 250 Nm of torque. The turbo petrol engine is the most powerful in the lineup with 160PS of power and 253 Nm of peak torque.
  • The 1.5-liter MPi Petrol engine is paired with both a 6-speed manual transmission (6MT) and an Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT) gearbox. The 1.5-liter U2 CRDi Diesel engine is available with a 6-speed manual transmission (6MT) and a 6-speed automatic transmission (6-speed AT) gearbox. The high-performance 1.5-liter Turbo GDi Petrol engine is matched with a 7-speed Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT) gearbox, offering superior driving experiences to customers. All powertrains are equipped with an Integrated Starter Generator (ISG), ensuring an optimal balance of performance and efficiency.
